title: Projection of Straight Lines — Types of Lines
description: A conceptual, guided tour of the six standard positions a straight line can take relative to the HP and VP: parallel to both, perpendicular to HP, perpendicular to VP, inclined to HP, inclined to VP, and inclined to both. Each step is its own mini-lesson — see why a projection reads the true length, why it foreshortens, why it collapses to a point, and how the Rotation Method recovers the true length when the line is inclined to both planes.
